cropExperiment.primaryEndpoint: mean paired RMSE in uV over all available comparable path points
cropExperiment.segmentationScope: Identical source-darkness evidence masks and independently known crop identity and calibration; no learned segmentation performance is inferred.
cropExperiment.fullPipelineAdmission: Only a candidate passing the paired crop criteria and model-rights/runtime checks proceeds to full-image promotion testing. Failure means no production change.

geometryExperiment.gridNodes: Known synthetic landmarks, not a production grid detector
geometryExperiment.productionAdmission: Requires independent grid-node detection and image-level evidence beyond this coordinate feasibility experiment.

verifierExperiment.policy: Advisory evidence; no automatic publication or morphology normalization.
